HTML & CSS.question: What does HTML stand for?
HTML & CSS.tip: HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language and defines the structure of web pages.

HTML & CSS.question: Which language is used for styling web pages?
HTML & CSS.tip: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) describes how HTML elements are to be displayed on screen.

JavaScript.question: Which of the following is a frontend JavaScript framework/library?
JavaScript.tip: React is an open-source JavaScript library developed by Facebook for building user interfaces.

JavaScript.question: Which operator is used for strict equality comparison in JavaScript?
JavaScript.tip: The '===' operator checks both value and data type without performing type coercion.
